Who the money goes to

One page for each company or group that Bay County, its cities, their redevelopment agencies or the tourism agencies paid or hired, with every record on this site behind it.

Vendors with a record from that government
The simple version

Reading a vendor page

  1. Awarded is not paid. A contract award is a promise to pay up to an amount. Payments come from check registers, which only some governments publish.
  2. One company, many spellings. Agendas, registers and campaign reports spell names differently. We combine spellings only when they are clearly the same company.
  3. Gifts are listed only for businesses. A campaign gift near a vote, or from a company that holds a contract, is a fact in two public records. It does not show why anyone voted the way they did, or how a contract was awarded.
